extDescription.message: Shows the public-transport commute time to your workplace, with steps and a map, on every idealista listing, and sorts results by it.

badgeLockedTitle.message: Commute Time: API keys locked, click to unlock

aiTitle.message: $N1$: $N2$ of $N3$ photos scanned, highest chance of AI $N4$

noPhotos.message: No listing photos found on this page

aiDisclaimer.message: Automatic estimate by Sightengine on a random sample, not proof. High scores can also come from virtual staging or heavy editing.

pagesBlocked.message: idealista asked for a check: sorting the pages loaded so far

sortPagesHint.message: When sorting by commute, also loads the other result pages (slowly, one at a time) and merges them into the list. They are removed when the sort is turned off

progNoPage.message: Open an idealista results page to see progress

progFailed.message: $N1$ without a result (no route, location or error)

progLoaded.message: Loaded $N1$ of $N2$ listings of this search

progOthersOnSort.message: The other pages are loaded when you sort by commute

progOthersOff.message: The other pages are not included (turn it on in the options)

errLocked.message: API keys are locked: click the extension icon and enter your passphrase.

errSetupWork.message: Set your work address in the extension options.

errRouteLimit.message: Monthly route limit ($N1$) reached in this browser; raise it in the options.

errPhotoLimit.message: Monthly photo limit ($N1$) reached in this browser; raise it in the options.

errNoSightKey.message: Photo check is set to use your own Sightengine key, but none is saved. Add it in the options.

errGeocoders.message: Geocoders unavailable (OpenStreetMap). Check your connection and the permissions in the options.

errNoGoogleKey.message: Add your Google Routes API key in the options (or switch to "My server").

errSightUnreachable.message: Sightengine not reachable (permission refused, or offline).

errServerUnreachable.message: Server not reachable at $N1$. Is it running? Check the server URL in the options.

popupNone.message: No encrypted keys yet. Add them in the options.

popupUnlocked.message: Keys unlocked until the browser closes.

optSub.message: Commute time and a fake-photo check on every idealista listing

optLockedHint.message: Your API keys are encrypted. Enter the passphrase to open the settings; it stays unlocked until the browser closes.

previewCap.message: Example of the row added to each listing

previewCapTo.message: Example of the row added to each listing, to $N1$

previewCapToBy.message: Example of the row added to each listing, to $N1$ by $N2$

cityHint.message: Added to listings that don't name one

pinHint.message: Reads each listing's map page, slowly. Falls back to the address if idealista objects

serverWhy.message: Your server is only used for the photo check

serverUrlHint.message: Leave empty for this machine, or enter an address such as 192.168.1.50 or https://commute.example.org

accessTokenHint.message: Only if the server sets ACCESS_TOKEN

tileUrlHint.message: Leave empty for OpenStreetMap, or use another provider's template with {z} {x} {y}. The attribution shown stays OpenStreetMap's: add your provider's if it requires one

browserNote.message: No server needed: this browser calls Google Routes with your key, and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim, Photon, map tiles) directly. Restrict the key to the Routes API in Google Cloud. It is stored encrypted with your passphrase (see Key passphrase), answers are cached here only, and the monthly limit is counted per browser.

aiServerHint.message: The server holds the credentials (SIGHTENGINE_USER, SIGHTENGINE_SECRET) and shares one cache and monthly limit.

sightNote.message: The browser calls Sightengine directly, no server needed. The credentials are stored encrypted with your passphrase (see Key passphrase).

vaultEncrypted.message: Keys are encrypted. To change them, enter the passphrase here when saving.

vaultNew.message: Choose a passphrase (8+ characters) to encrypt your API keys. You will unlock it from the toolbar icon once per browser session. It cannot be recovered: if you forget it, re-enter the keys.

testNoRouting.message: Reached the server, but it has no routing backend (set GOOGLE_API_KEY in server/.env)

saveNeedGoogle.message: Not saved: enter your Google Routes API key, or choose "My server".

saveNeedSight.message: Not saved: enter your Sightengine API user and secret, or choose "My server".

saveNeedPass.message: Not saved: enter a passphrase of at least 8 characters to encrypt the keys.

saveBadTile.message: Not saved: the map tiles URL must be https and contain {z}, {x} and {y}.

savePermRefused.message: Not saved: permission to reach the services you chose to call from this browser was refused (choose "My server" instead).

saveBadServer.message: Not saved: the server URL is invalid, or the permission to reach it was refused.

saveKeysFailed.message: Settings saved, but the keys were not: $N1$

saved.message: Saved. Reload your idealista tab to apply.
